title: Viva Glint: configure a data retention policy for survey data
summary: Hold: the briefing says Microsoft states there is no charge for the control, but the documentation does not state that. It also leaves General Settings change logging wholly open although Learn documents that activity, and its claim to be the first documented retention mechanism is unsupported.

claims.where: What's changing; Scope; summary; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The roadmap describes Glint service administrators configuring retention for their Glint instances according to organisational policy.
claims.quote: This feature will introduce the capability for Glint service administrators to configure a data retention policy for their Glint instances based on the organizational policies.

claims.where: What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap description covers past engagement, always-on, lifecycle and 360 survey cycles.
claims.quote: Any past survey cycles including engagement surveys, always-on surveys, lifecycle surveys and 360s will be retained/deleted based on this data retention configuration period.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Viva Glint has a Data retention policy control that defines how long the instance holds survey data.
claims.quote: Use the Data retention policy control to define the data retention policy for your Glint instance.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The control is admin-opt-in for age-based deletion: its default retains data while the subscription is active until an administrator chooses a custom period.
claims.quote: Until subscription ends (default) | Glint data is retained indefinitely as long as the tenant has an active Viva Glint subscription.

claims.where: controls[0].note; What's changing; Governance guidance; rendered controls
claims.claim: The two policy values are Until subscription ends and Custom time period.
claims.quote: Until subscription ends (default) | Glint data is retained indefinitely as long as the tenant has an active Viva Glint subscription. ... Custom time period

claims.where: controls[0].note; What's changing; Governance guidance; rendered controls
claims.claim: The custom retention period must be a numerical value between 6 and 1000 months.
claims.quote: Enter a numerical retention period (in months) to define the data retention time period. The value must be between 6-1000 months.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; rationale: risk and impact
claims.claim: When the retention period is met, applicable survey data is permanently deleted.
claims.quote: When the retention period is met, applicable Glint survey data is permanently deleted.

claims.where: controls[0].note; What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Deletion under this policy is irreversible and the deleted data cannot be recovered.
claims.quote: This action is irreversible & deleted data cannot be recovered.

claims.where: controls[0].scope and note; Risk assessment; Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: General Settings changes, including this instance-level policy, apply to all survey programs.
claims.quote: Any initial actions or subsequent changes in General Settings apply to all survey programs in your Viva Glint platform.

claims.where: What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The policy does not apply to configurations set in place.
claims.quote: This does not apply to configurations set in place.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Recurring, ad-hoc and lifecycle engagement surveys are evaluated using the survey cycle end date once the cycle is Completed.
claims.quote: Engagement surveys (Recurring, Ad‑hoc, Lifecycle) will be evaluated for retention based on the survey cycle end date, once the survey cycle is in a Completed state.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Always-on surveys are evaluated using the survey response date.
claims.quote: Always on surveys, based on survey response date.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance
claims.claim: 360 surveys are evaluated using the feedback cycle effective due date.
claims.quote: 360 surveys are subject to retention based on the feedback cycle effective due date (the latest subject due date, or the cycle due date if no subjects exist).

claims.where: What's changing; Scope; Risk assessment
claims.claim: Focus Areas and Goals are subject to retention using their due date.
claims.quote: Focus Areas & Goals based on due date.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Historical imports older than the configured retention policy are deleted shortly after import finishes.
claims.quote: If the historical data being imported is older than the data retention policy in place, that imported data will be deleted shortly after the import finishes.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; What's changing; Governance controls; rendered controls
claims.claim: The control is in the Viva Glint admin dashboard at Configuration > Service Configuration > General Settings > User Data > Data retention policy.
claims.quote: Select the Configuration symbol on your Viva Glint admin dashboard and then General Settings in the Service Configuration section. ... User Data ... Data retention policy

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls; rendered controls
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no PowerShell, Microsoft Graph or other API to configure this Data retention policy as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint data retention policy PowerShell Microsoft Graph API configure retention settings; "Viva Glint" "retention" "Graph" API. Read General Settings and returned Glint data-residency and Purview cmdlet excerpts; no applicable operation.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance guidance; rendered controls
claims.claim: Service Admin assignment is in Microsoft 365 admin center at Settings > Viva > Viva Glint > Assign Glint service admin > Add users.
claims.quote: Go to Settings and select Viva. ... In the list of applications, select Viva Glint. ... Select Assign Glint service admin and choose Add users.

claims.where: controls[1].api; rendered controls
claims.claim: Microsoft documents no API or automation call for assigning the Viva Glint Service Admin role.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint Service Admin assign role Microsoft Graph PowerShell automation; "Viva Glint" "Service Admin" "API" assignment. Read assignment page and key-role excerpts; generic Entra role/app assignment results did not identify this role.

claims.where: Risk assessment; controls[1].governs; Governance controls
claims.claim: Service Admins own the Viva Glint app and have access to all administrative functionality, including its General Settings control.
claims.quote: Users in this role are the "owners" of the Viva Glint app, having access to all administrative functionality and all survey data within the app.

claims.where: Risk assessment
claims.claim: Learn recommends typically assigning no more than five Service Admins.
claims.quote: At least one Service Admin is required, and typically no more than 5 users assigned to this role is recommended.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment; Governance controls; rendered controls
claims.claim: Only a Microsoft 365 Global Administrator or Viva Glint Tenant Administrator can add or remove Service Admins through Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: Users can only be added/removed to this role by a Microsoft 365 Global Administrator or a Viva Glint Tenant Administrator from the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The setting takes the included licensing model of Viva Glint, which requires a Viva Suite or Viva Glint subscription plan.
claims.quote: The purchase of a Viva Suite or Viva Glint subscription plan is required for using Microsoft Viva Glint.

claims.where: Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Individual user licence assignment is not required for using Viva Glint.
claims.quote: Individual user license assignment isn't required for using Viva Glint.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: As of November 2026, Microsoft Learn publishes no separate licence, meter or price specific to this control.
claims.quote: Searched: "Viva Glint" "data retention policy" licensing price; Viva Glint data retention policy licensing price meter first retention policy audit deletion schedule. Read licensing and General Settings pages and returned licensing excerpts; no control-specific charge.

claims.where: Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn states that there is no charge specific to the retention control.
claims.quote: Searched: "Viva Glint" "data retention policy" licensing price; Viva Glint data retention policy licensing price meter first retention policy audit deletion schedule. Read General Settings and Viva Glint licensing; neither states the control has no charge.
claims.fix: Remove 'and Microsoft Learn states no charge specific to it at the time of writing (November 2026)'. Keep the preceding narrower statement that the control's Learn page lists no separate licence, meter or price.

claims.where: Why it matters
claims.claim: This is the first documented way to make Glint retention follow organisational records policy instead of the subscription term.
claims.quote: Searched: "Viva Glint" "data retention" "first". Read General Settings and returned data-residency, deletion and role excerpts; none establishes that no earlier documented mechanism existed.
claims.fix: Replace the first sentence with 'This gives a service owner a documented way to make Glint retention follow the organisation's own records policy instead of the subscription term.'

claims.where: Open questions: Activity Audit Log
claims.claim: Whether a retention-policy change is recorded in the Activity Audit Log is wholly undocumented.
claims.quote: Details changes saved | Change activity in General Settings or Advanced Configuration: Details.
claims.fix: Replace the audit question with 'Learn documents Details changes saved as change activity in General Settings. Which event specifically identifies a Data retention policy change? Watch the Activity Audit Log and Purview audit log activities pages on Microsoft Learn.' Do not claim a retention-specific event is documented.

claims.where: Open questions: deletion schedule
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the precise deletion schedule after a cycle reaches the retention period.
claims.quote: Searched: "Viva Glint" "Data retention policy" audit schedule deletion. Read General Settings and returned data-residency and deletion excerpts; policy text says 'When the retention period is met' but gives no precise processing schedule.

claims.where: Open questions: GCC availability
claims.claim: The cited GCC feature-availability page does not name the Data retention policy control.
claims.quote: Searched the entire fetched supported-environments page for Data retention policy and retention. Its table lists survey administration and other capabilities but does not name this control.
